headline: JSW Infrastructure QIP and Promoter OFS announced under SEBI ICDR 2018
sum: JSW Infrastructure announced a qualified institutions placement (QIP) of equity shares and a parallel offer for sale (OFS) by promoter Sajjan Jindal Family Trust, structured under SEBI ICDR Regulations 2018 Chapter VI and Companies Act Sections 42 and 62.
detail: JSW Infrastructure's Finance Committee approved a dual-leg capital market transaction: (i) a QIP of equity shares (face value ₹2 each) by the company to raise primary capital, and (ii) a parallel OFS of equity shares by the Sajjan Jindal Family Trust (the founder-promoter vehicle) to achieve secondary liquidity. Both tranches fall under SEBI ICDR Regulations 2018 Chapter VI (QIP rules) and Companies Act 2013 Sections 42 (private placement) and 62 (issue of bonus/preferential shares). The dual structure allows the promoter to diversify while the company accesses institutional capital without a rights issue or open offer.
